template._note: The IC-LoRA was trained on one bucket: 768x448, 121 frames, 24 fps (model card, and the workflow's notes). A shot renders its own length on the 8k+1 grid, from 49 frames (2 s) to 481 (20 s): the reference video is the sheet looped (RepeatImageBatch) to exactly the shot's frame count, and the only hard rule, in ComfyUI's LTXVAddGuide, is that a guide is no longer than the output. Lengths other than 121 are outside the IC-LoRA's training, so the build warns (identity may weaken) but renders them; a shot longer than 20 s must be split. Sizes are multiples of 32 (one sampling stage, no upscaler).

recipe._note: One reference sheet per shot, composed at queue time from the picked (live) ref files: one panel per element, in order, characters (ONE panel of each 4-panel sheet: the face panel on a single-character close-up, the three-quarter body panel otherwise, as the H3 loader picks), then props and vehicles, then the location plate, at the render size, no text: the panels tile the whole sheet in rows or columns with thin black lines between them and no black bands around it (a sheet framed by black bars rendered a letterboxed shot); the plate is cropped to fill its cell, a figure only at the sides (to 60% of its width at most), the rest of its cell black. The sheet loops to a static video (RepeatImageBatch) that conditions the whole clip through LTXVAddGuide + the ingredients IC-LoRA. Every ref is required, like H3's pictures; rendering anyway drops the missing elements from the sheet and from the prompt's `Reference sheet:` half (they stay described in words), and a shot with no refs at all renders text-only (no sheet, no IC-LoRA). LTX makes the soundtrack with the picture: clone / dub / dub_keep_foley render with generate and say so.

policy_fallback.why: LTX-2 generates sound with the picture and takes no voice sample or recording

size_hints.background plate: 1344x768 (any landscape size: it becomes one panel of the sheet)

binding._note: The workflow is ComfyUI's LTX-2.3 IC-LoRA ingredients template (a subgraph, flattened by h3jobs.ui_to_api). Every value is patched into a widget; the sheet reaches the template's LoadImage through POST /upload/image, then RepeatImageBatch (length frames) and ResizeAndPadImage (the render size, black) make the static reference video. H3SaveShot takes the place of CreateVideo/SaveVideo, and prune drops what it doesn't need: the prompt enhancer (TextGenerateLTX2Prompt, its Gemma LoRA and switch), the size/length maths and the previews. The checkpoint name goes to all three of the template's loaders (model, audio VAE, text encoder).

presets._note: LTX-2.3 22B distilled (fp8) with the ingredients IC-LoRA at the template's 1.0, one stage of 8 steps (KSampler euler_ancestral / linear_quadratic, cfg 1), as the template runs it. The final is the trained bucket, 768x448; the proxy is the bucket scaled by 2/3 and snapped to the grid, 512x288. The model card's settings for the dev model (LoRA 1.4, 30 steps, guidance 4) are not the distilled template's; a dev final (dev checkpoint + the distilled LoRA at 0.75 + ingredients) is a profile away. Sizes come from here, not from another target's series config block: the IC-LoRA only knows its bucket. The negative prompt is the model card's suggestion plus the artefacts a review cut can't use.

final.negative: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted, flickering, morphing, extra limbs, watermark, subtitles

proxy.negative: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted, flickering, morphing, extra limbs, watermark, subtitles
